name: Function_29_5090
evidence: idea: start of a 742-byte unreferenced routine library (LCDC bit2 toggles, OAM copy/clear, PRNG hl=hl*5+$3711, wait LY=$90, ROM bank write, CGB palette fade via rBCPS with buffer $DBD0); no caller/pointer found, never executed

name: Function_29_5117
evidence: idea: busy-wait until rLY == $90 (start of VBlank); helper of the unreferenced palette-fade library 29:5090-5376

name: Function_29_511E
evidence: idea: frame-pacing wait of the library: call $7BB7 (joypad read), then wait for LY $24/$48/$6C/$90 when A is held, else $48/$90

name: Function_29_5145
evidence: idea: rIF=0 and clears IE bit0 (VBlank interrupt off) around palette transfers

name: Function_29_514F
evidence: idea: rIF=0 and sets IE bit0 (VBlank interrupt on again)

name: Function_29_520D
evidence: idea: reads all 64 BG palette bytes (rBCPS/rBCPD) and 64 OBJ bytes (rOCPS/rOCPD) into the WRAM1 buffer $DBD0 (saves the current CGB palettes for a fade)

name: Function_29_523F
evidence: idea: writes the 128 bytes at $DBD0 back to BG/OBJ palette RAM (rBCPD/rOCPD): restores/updates palettes after a fade step

name: Function_29_529F
evidence: idea: fade step toward white: adds 1 to each 5-bit R/G/B channel of the 64 RGB555 colours at $DBD0 (clamped at $1F)

name: Function_29_52ED
evidence: idea: fade step toward black: subtracts 1 from each 5-bit R/G/B channel of the 64 RGB555 colours at $DBD0 (floor 0)

name: Function_29_5335
evidence: idea: copies 64 bytes from HL twice into $DBD0 (fills the fade buffer with one palette block for BG and OBJ)
